list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete, centrosymmetric [Yb6F8(O2CCF3)12(H2O)4]2− anion contains an octahedral array of six Yb(III) ions with eight μ3-fluorido ligands capping its faces. Trifluoroacetate ligands bridge the core edges in the ammonium-associated disorder component; in the oxonium-associated component, one trifluoroacetate binds monodentately and the aqua-ligand coordination changes. Mixed ammonium/oxonium counterions and lattice water complete the crystal.

synthesis.procedure: Ytterbium metal was dissolved in liquid ammonia dried over sodium, and ammonium trifluoroacetate was added. After evaporation of ammonia, the residue was dried under vacuum to 10−3 hPa. A 100 mg portion of the resulting greenish powder was stirred in anhydrous trifluoroacetic acid. Insoluble material was allowed to settle overnight; the supernatant was transferred to an ampoule and left open to air, yielding colorless crystals of the title compound within one week.

title: Mixed crystal of bis(ammonium/oxonium) tetraaqua-fluorido-trifluoroacetato-octahedro-hexaytterbiate(III) tetrahydrate, containing a hexanuclear ytterbium(III) carboxylate complex with face-capping fluoride ligands and comprising an unusual kind of substitutional disorder
